comprehensive-workflow-reminder-manageme.reason: handleCancelBooking first collected the delete promises and awaited them via Promise.all in #14864 (2024-05-10). The remaining unawaited forEach sites (workflow delete/update/activateEventType handlers) were all replaced in #15083 ('use deleteAllWorkflowReminders everywhere') by an awaited deleteAllWorkflowReminders that runs Promise.allSettled; reschedule paths were already awaited by then. From 2024-07-08 every caller named in the bug awaits the reminder cancellation.

#8026 moved the try/catch inside the for loop in scheduleEmailReminders.ts, so each SendGrid cancel and its row update (now update scheduled:false, awaited per reminder) succeed or fail independently; one failing cancel no longer aborts the others. Later versions use Promise.allSettled over per-reminder cancel/update promises.

The deferred SendGrid cancellation (flag cancelled:true, cancel later in the 15-min cron) was kept and even extended (#7647). #20293 (2025-04-09) moved workflow emails to SMTP via the tasker, where deleteScheduledEmailReminder cancels the task immediately (tasker.cancelWithReference), and #23591 removed SendGrid scheduling from emailReminderManager entirely, leaving the cron path only as a deprecated legacy path. The change was a provider migration, not a fix aimed at the cutoff; the whole code was then removed on 2026-04-15 (#28903).

deleteScheduledSMSReminder kept twilio.cancelSMS and prisma.workflowReminder.delete in the same try with no separate DB cleanup through the last version before removal (smsReminderManager.ts at 353f71bdc69, 2026-03-16). Callers still delegate deletion to it (deleteAllWorkflowReminders). The file was removed with all of packages/features/ee by #28903 on 2026-04-15, without any change targeting this bug.
